excerpts.text: The [2026 Winter Olympics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Winter_Olympics "2026 Winter Olympics"), officially known as the XXV Winter Olympic Games, were an international winter [multi-sport event](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Multi-sport_event "Multi-sport event") held in [Milan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Milan "Milan") and [Cortina d'Ampezzo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cortina_d'Ampezzo "Cortina d'Ampezzo"), Italy, from 6 to 22 February.

excerpts.text: A total of 2,900 athletes representing 92 [National Olympic Committees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Olympic_Committee "National Olympic Committee") (NOCs) participated,[[1]](#cite_note-1) including first-time entrants [Benin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Benin_at_the_2026_Winter_Olympics "Benin at the 2026 Winter Olympics"), [Guinea-Bissau](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guinea-Bissau_at_the_2026_Winter_Olympics "Guinea-Bissau at the 2026 Winter Olympics"), and the [United Arab Emirates](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Arab_Emirates_at_the_2026_Winter_Olympics "United Arab Emirates at the 2026 Winter Olympics").[[2]](#cite_note-2)[[3]](#cite_note-3)[[4]](#cite_note-4) The games featured 116 events in eight [sports](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olympic_sports "Olympic sports") across 16 disciplines, including [ski mountaineering](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ski_mountaineering "Ski mountaineering"), which made its Olympic debut.[[5]](#cite_note-5)[[6]](#cite_note-6)

excerpts.text: The 2026 Winter Olympics featured 116 medal events in 16 disciplines, an increase of seven events and one discipline over [Beijing 2022](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Winter_Olympics "2022 Winter Olympics").

At the 138th IOC Session on 20 July 2021, the IOC approved a proposal by the Fondazione Milano Cortina 2026 to add [ski mountaineering](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ski_mountaineering "Ski mountaineering") as a debuting optional sport.[[58]](#cite_note-61) It consisted of three medal events: men's sprint, women's sprint, and mixed relay.[[53]](#cite_note-:3-56)

excerpts.text:
The Association of IOC Recognised International Sports Federations (ARISF) proudly congratulates the International Ski Mountaineering Federation (ISMF), a valued member of ARISF, on its historic participation at the Milano Cortina 2026 Olympic Winter Games.

Included as the first additional sport in the Olympic Winter Games, ski mountaineering featured three medal events, Men’s Sprint, Women’s Sprint and Mixed Relay, with 36 athletes (18 women and 18 men).
